review_type: Independent read-only final protocol audit while the approved GPU runs are active

common_config.backbone: ViT-B/16, two independent frozen transformer branches
common_config.pretraining: Same pinned AugReg IN21K -> IN1K Base NPZ and matched exported learned initialization
common_config.statistics: 10 multi-centroids per class, NumPy population variance ddof=0, float64 stored mean/variance
common_config.prefix_layout: Preserved author dual/batch reshape; permute correction disabled
common_config.precision: FP32 model; no autocast; CUDA matmul TF32 disabled; cuDNN TF32 enabled; deterministic cuDNN

correctness_findings.finding: At effective WD0, timm0.9.8 create_optimizer may retain frozen parameters in its group. Its Adam step skips grad=None tensors. Reference filters to the TII residual MLP/head, matching native parameter order and active updates. Adam betas, eps, LR, WD and foreach defaults match.
correctness_findings.limit: The number of parameters merely referenced by the optimizer group differs from the literal factory output; allocated optimizer state and algorithm updates remain the same for frozen grad=None tensors.

correctness_findings.area: Prompt training optimizer and LR schedule
correctness_findings.finding: Both paths create fresh Adam at every task/phase, with prompt LR0.0075 and head LR0.00075. Reference timm StepLRScheduler.step(local_epoch) runs after training. Native max(local_epoch-1,0)//30 matches it: first decay is used at zero-based epoch31 / human epoch32. Warmup is zero.

Task1 skips CA. Task2 runs 30 epochs x10 old-class minibatches =300 SGD steps per branch. Momentum0.9, cosine T_max30 and effective WD0 match. Author group WD0 overrides the SGD constructor default5e-4. TII draws64 and prompted CA draws320 Gaussian samples per nondegenerate centroid, and both shuffle with CPU randperm.

TII statistics use raw CLS before its residual MLP. Prompt statistics use the finalized prefix, current-task forced selection and momentum0. Means/variances preserve source float64 promotion; orthogonality uses old prompt centroids plus current features, unnormalized Gram matrix, temperature0.8 and weight0.1. Diagonal Gaussian covariance uses the source1e-4 jitter.
correctness_findings.limit: Full covariance and variance alternative modes are outside the approved run. Their CPU synthetic parity does not establish 768-dimensional CUDA bitwise equivalence.

correctness_findings.finding: Both retain the source reshape without dual/batch permutation. Training shares shuffled sample order and worker augmentation seeds. Statistics form stable per-class subsets before forward with batch64 and no dropped tail. Evaluation forwards separate native test-task loaders; sorting saved predictions by raw IDs happens after forward and therefore does not change prefix batch layout.
Author training masks noncurrent columns to -inf in a100-column tensor. Native masks old columns and slices unseen columns away. They define the same current-class CE objective.
correctness_findings.limit: Different CUDA reduction widths and MVN matrix-vector versus native diagonal-noise matrix-multiply implementations need not be bitwise identical. Input/label/seed equality is the strict first-batch gate; loss/gradient diagnostics and the accepted accuracy margins provide empirical checks.

acknowledged_runtime_adaptations: User-selected batch64, seed1993, fixed class order and AugReg IN21K->IN1K checkpoint replace launcher defaults.
Interleaved per-task TII/statistics/CA/prompt/statistics/CA replaces separate all-TII and prompt launches, with explicit phase RNG to remove cross-stage global-RNG dependence.
Explicit matched learned initialization, KMeans policy and stable per-class statistics batching replace implicit constructor/sklearn/random-sampler behavior.

Reference seen-only prompt-logit evaluation matches Mammoth class-IL. The pinned author default evaluate function leaves all100 prompt columns unless task_inc is used. This is a declared evaluation adaptation; no oracle task is used.
Single-process gather copies and unwrapped prompt updates replace distributed barriers/all_gather/model.module references.
Shared existing CIFAR data, shared local NPZ and fail-closed CIFAR download guards replace download-enabled dataset construction.

Native fixed registered statistics buffers allocate all100 classes and temporarily collect current-class features on CPU; source dictionaries allocate only seen statistics and source extraction holds current-class features on GPU. These change resource overhead but not selected statistics mathematics.

Native transfers non_augmented inputs and runs framework wrappers/checkpoint diagnostics; reference uses pair-adapted native batches. Validation resource figures include each runner overhead and are not an equal compute budget result.

conclusion.interpretation: The active run validates the native port against an independent source-derived reference under the explicitly matched protocol. It is not an untouched author launcher or paper-number reproduction.
